title: Aaron Glenn: Garrett Wilson sideline conversation "overblown," we want to get him the ball

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Aaron Glenn: Garrett Wilson sideline conversation "overblown," we want to get him the ball
sources.description: Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson was seen in an animated conversation with quarterback Geno Smith and assistant coaches on the bench during Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins, but it's not an issue for head coach Aaron Glenn.
